stick.hat.1.name: POV hat
stick.hat.1.note: dark hat cap on the top right of the head

stick.button.thumb.1.name: Head button
stick.button.thumb.1.note: red button on the top left (front) of the head

unplaced.stick.trigger: red button on the front of the grip below the head (trigger or a button above it, not certain)
unplaced.stick.button.thumb.2: dark lever at the lower front of the grip (likely a pinky button)

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), the stick seen from its left side and slightly from the front, front of the grip to the left
mappingSource: catalog (thrustmaster.json, confidence low): Thrustmaster's Top Gun USB driver INF (TMUSB.INF in https://ts.thrustmaster.com/download/accessories/pc/joysticks/exe/tgunusb/topgunusb.zip) registers 4 buttons and a POV hat, no Z axis; "which number sits where is not documented -> controls without input". No manual on the support page (https://support.thrustmaster.com/en/product/topgunusb-en/)
note: Very small photo (250 px) and no vendor figure. Only the red button on the head and the hat cap on top are clear. The red button on the front of the grip may be the trigger or a button above the trigger, and the dark lever at the lower front may be a pinky button; both are hidden candidates.
